value.message: Town of Oakville has Learn to Swim Preschool A Saturdays 9:00, and Preschool B at 9:40, both Sept 12 to Nov 28, ages 3-5, no parent in the water - their site says. Registration opens Tues Aug 11 at 7am; I could not pin down the price, but I'll keep watching and text you when I have it.
